examples.en: Books are expensive in this city.
examples.fa: کتاب‌ها در این شهر گران‌اند.

examples.en: She plays the piano very well.
examples.fa: او خیلی خوب پیانو می‌نوازد.

exercises.prompt: He is ___ engineer.
exercises.why_en: Engineer begins with a vowel sound, and the job is not yet known.
exercises.why_fa: engineer با صدای واکه آغاز می‌شود و شغل هنوز شناخته‌شده نیست.

exercises.prompt: Please close ___ door — it's cold.
exercises.why_en: There is only one door in the room, so both people know which.
exercises.why_fa: در اتاق یک در هست، پس هر دو می‌دانند کدام در.

exercises.prompt: I don't drink ___ coffee at night.
exercises.why_en: Coffee in general is noncount, so it takes no article.
exercises.why_fa: coffee در معنای کلی غیرقابل‌شمارش است، پس حرف تعریف نمی‌گیرد.

exam.q: She bought ___ umbrella.
exam.why_en: Umbrella starts with a vowel sound.
exam.why_fa: umbrella با صدای مصوت شروع می‌شود.

exam.q: ___ sun rises in the east.
exam.why_en: There is only one sun.
exam.why_fa: خورشید یکی است.

exam.q: I like ___ music from the north.
exam.why_en: Music in general takes no article.
exam.why_fa: موسیقی به‌طور کلی بدون حرف تعریف می‌آید.

lessons.title: Pronouns, possessive adjectives and other
lessons.use_en: A subject pronoun does the action, an object pronoun receives it, and a possessive adjective stands before a noun. Other becomes others when it stands alone.
lessons.use_fa: ضمیر فاعلی کار را انجام می‌دهد، ضمیر مفعولی آن را می‌گیرد، و صفت ملکی پیش از اسم می‌آید. other وقتی تنها و بدون اسم بیاید، others می‌شود.
lessons.form_en: I / me / my   |   other + noun   |   others (alone)

examples.en: She gave me her notebook.
examples.fa: او دفترش را به من داد.

examples.en: Some students left early; others stayed.
examples.fa: بعضی دانش‌آموزان زود رفتند؛ بقیه ماندند.

examples.en: I have two pens: one is blue, the other is black.
examples.fa: دو خودکار دارم: یکی آبی است، دیگری مشکی.

exercises.prompt: This is Ali and this is ___ sister.
exercises.why_en: Ali is male singular, so the possessive adjective is his.
exercises.why_fa: علی مفرد و مذکر است، پس صفت ملکی his می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: We called the doctor, but ___ was busy.
exercises.why_en: A singular person in subject position takes a subject pronoun.
exercises.why_fa: یک شخص مفرد در جایگاه فاعل، ضمیر فاعلی می‌گیرد.

exercises.prompt: Some of the cakes are fresh; ___ are old.
exercises.why_en: The pronoun stands alone for other cakes.
exercises.why_fa: ضمیر به‌تنهایی جانشین other cakes می‌شود.

exam.q: ___ bag is this?
exam.why_en: Possession before a noun is whose.
exam.why_fa: مالکیت پیش از اسم با whose بیان می‌شود.

exam.q: I like these shoes. Could I try ___ on?
exam.why_en: After a verb the object pronoun is used.
exam.why_fa: پس از فعل، ضمیر مفعولی می‌آید.

exam.q: Two girls were waiting; ___ were laughing.
exam.why_en: The subject of the sentence needs a subject pronoun.
exam.why_fa: فاعل جمله ضمیر فاعلی می‌خواهد.

lessons.title: Reflexive pronouns
lessons.use_en: A reflexive pronoun points back to the subject: the subject and the object are the same person. It can also add emphasis, meaning “that person and nobody else”.
lessons.use_fa: ضمیر بازتابی به نهاد برمی‌گردد: فاعل و مفعول یک نفرند. همچنین می‌تواند تأکید بیفزاید، یعنی «خودِ همان شخص و نه کس دیگر».
lessons.form_en: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves

examples.en: I cut myself while cooking.
examples.fa: هنگام آشپزی خودم را بریدم.

examples.en: They built the house themselves.
examples.fa: خودشان خانه را ساختند.

examples.en: Help yourself to tea.
examples.fa: خودت چای بردار.

exercises.prompt: She taught ___ to play the guitar.
exercises.why_en: She and the person taught are the same.
exercises.why_fa: فاعل و کسی که آموزش می‌بیند یکی است.

exercises.prompt: We enjoyed ___ at the party.
exercises.why_en: The subject is we, so the reflexive is ourselves.
exercises.why_fa: نهاد we است، پس ضمیر بازتابی ourselves می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: The manager ___ answered the phone.
exercises.why_en: Here it emphasizes: the manager and not an assistant.
exercises.why_fa: اینجا تأکید است: خود مدیر و نه منشی.

exam.q: Be careful, or you will hurt ___ .
exam.why_en: The subject is you.
exam.why_fa: فاعل you است.

exam.q: The children dressed ___ .
exam.why_en: The plural reflexive of they is themselves.
exam.why_fa: ضمیر انعکاسیِ جمعِ they می‌شود themselves.

exam.q: I made the cake ___ .
exam.why_en: Emphasis on the subject, which is I.
exam.why_fa: تأکید روی فاعل است، که I است.

lessons.title: Modals of necessity and advice: must, have to, should
lessons.title_fa: فعل‌های وجهی الزام و توصیه: must، have to، should
lessons.use_en: Must and have to say something is necessary; must not forbids and do not have to says it is not necessary. Should and ought to give advice. Had better warns that something bad follows if you do not.
lessons.use_fa: must و have to الزام را می‌گویند؛ must not ممنوعیت است و do not have to یعنی لازم نیست. should و ought to توصیه می‌دهند. had better هشدار می‌دهد که بی‌توجهی پیامد بدی دارد.
lessons.form_en: modal + base verb (no to after must, should, had better)

examples.en: You must wear a seatbelt.
examples.fa: باید کمربند ایمنی ببندی.

examples.en: I have to work on Saturday.
examples.fa: شنبه باید کار کنم.

examples.en: You should see a doctor about that cough.
examples.fa: بهتر است برای آن سرفه به پزشک مراجعه کنی.

exercises.prompt: You ___ smoke here — it's a hospital.
exercises.why_en: It is forbidden, not merely unnecessary.
exercises.why_fa: ممنوع است، نه فقط لازم‌نبودن.

exercises.prompt: It's Sunday, so I ___ (not / have to) get up early.
exercises.why_en: No necessity; do not have to is the absence of obligation.
exercises.why_fa: الزامی نیست؛ don't have to یعنی نبودِ اجبار.

exercises.prompt: You ___ (should) tell her the truth.
exercises.why_en: Advice takes should, followed by the base verb.
exercises.why_fa: توصیه با should و فعل ساده می‌آید.

exam.q: Passengers ___ remain seated during take-off.
exam.why_en: A rule, so necessity.
exam.why_fa: قانون است، پس ناچاری (must).

exam.q: You ___ take an umbrella; it looks like rain.
exam.why_en: A suggestion, not a rule.
exam.why_fa: پیشنهاد است، نه قانون.

exam.q: She ___ come if she is busy.
exam.why_en: It is optional, not forbidden.
exam.why_fa: اختیاری است، نه ممنوع.

lessons.title: Ability and possibility: can, could, may, might
lessons.title_fa: توانایی و احتمال: can، could، may، might
lessons.use_en: Can is ability or permission now, could is past ability, and may or might is possibility, with might a little less certain.
lessons.use_fa: can توانایی یا اجازه در حال است، could توانایی در گذشته، و may یا might احتمال است، با این تفاوت که might کمی کمتر مطمئن است.
lessons.form_en: can / could + verb   |   may / might + verb

examples.en: She can speak three languages.
examples.fa: او می‌تواند سه زبان صحبت کند.

examples.en: When I was a child I could swim very well.
examples.fa: وقتی بچه بودم خوب شنا می‌کردم.

examples.en: It might rain later, so take a coat.
examples.fa: شاید بعداً باران بیاید، پس کاپشن بردار.

exercises.prompt: He ___ (not / can) come today; he is ill.
exercises.why_en: Can is followed by the base verb, and not makes it cannot.
exercises.why_fa: پس از can فعل ساده می‌آید و not آن را به cannot تبدیل می‌کند.

exercises.prompt: You ___ use my phone if you need it.
exercises.why_en: Permission is given with may or can.
exercises.why_fa: اجازه دادن با may یا can انجام می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: She ___ read at the age of four.
exercises.why_en: Past ability uses could.
exercises.why_fa: توانایی در گذشته با could بیان می‌شود.

exam.q: Take an umbrella; it ___ rain.
exam.why_en: A possibility, not a certainty.
exam.why_fa: احتمال است، نه قطعیت.

exam.q: I ___ drive a car, but I cannot drive a truck.
exam.why_en: Ability uses can.
exam.why_fa: توانایی با can بیان می‌شود.

exam.q: After the accident he ___ not walk for a month.
exam.why_en: The inability belongs to the past.
exam.why_fa: ناتوانی مربوط به گذشته است.

lessons.title: Requests and suggestions: could you, would you mind, let's
lessons.title_fa: درخواست و پیشنهاد: could you، would you mind، let's
lessons.use_en: A polite request uses could you or would you; would you mind is followed by -ing; a suggestion uses let's, why don't we or should we.
lessons.use_fa: درخواست مؤدبانه با could you یا would you می‌آید؛ پس از would you mind فعل ing می‌گیرد؛ پیشنهاد با let's، why don't we یا should we ساخته می‌شود.
lessons.form_en: Could you + verb?   |   Would you mind + verb-ing?   |   Let's + verb

examples.en: Could you open the window, please?
examples.fa: می‌شود لطفاً پنجره را باز کنید؟

examples.en: Would you mind waiting a few minutes?
examples.fa: ناراحت می‌شوید چند دقیقه صبر کنید؟

examples.en: Let's take a taxi; it is raining.
examples.fa: بیا تاکسی بگیریم؛ باران می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: ___ you close the door, please?
exercises.why_en: Could you makes the request polite.
exercises.why_fa: could you درخواست را مؤدبانه می‌کند.

exercises.prompt: Would you mind ___ (turn) the music down?
exercises.why_en: Mind takes an -ing form.
exercises.why_fa: پس از mind فعل ing می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: ___ go to the beach this weekend?
exercises.why_en: Should we with the base verb makes a suggestion.
exercises.why_fa: should we با فعل ساده پیشنهاد می‌سازد.

exam.q: ___ you mind speaking more slowly?
exam.why_en: The fixed polite form is would you mind.
exam.why_fa: شکل مؤدبانهٔ ثابت would you mind است.

exam.q: Why ___ we meet at seven?
exam.why_en: Why don't we is the suggestion pattern.
exam.why_fa: why don't we الگوی پیشنهاد است.

exam.q: Could you ___ me the salt?
exam.why_en: A modal is followed by the base verb.
exam.why_fa: پس از فعل کمکی، فعل ساده می‌آید.

lessons.title: Degrees of certainty: must be, may be, can't be
lessons.title_fa: درجات اطمینان: must be، may be، can't be
lessons.use_en: Must be means you are almost sure; may be or might be means possible; can't be means you are sure it is not true. For the past, add have and the past participle.
lessons.use_fa: must be یعنی تقریباً مطمئنید؛ may be یا might be یعنی ممکن است؛ can't be یعنی مطمئنید که درست نیست. برای گذشته، have و اسم مفعول اضافه می‌شود.
lessons.form_en: must / may / might / can't + be   |   must have + past participle

examples.en: The lights are on, so she must be at home.
examples.fa: چراغ‌ها روشن است، پس او باید خانه باشد.

examples.en: He may be in a meeting; I am not sure.
examples.fa: شاید در جلسه باشد؛ مطمئن نیستم.

examples.en: They can't be serious about closing the shop.
examples.fa: آن‌ها نمی‌توانند جدی باشند که مغازه را می‌بندند.

exercises.prompt: She is not answering. She ___ (must / be) asleep.
exercises.why_en: The silence is strong evidence, so must be.
exercises.why_fa: بی‌پاسخ ماندن شاهد قوی است، پس must be.

exercises.prompt: He ___ (can't / finish) already; he started an hour ago.
exercises.why_en: Certainty about the past uses can't have + past participle.
exercises.why_fa: اطمینان دربارهٔ گذشته با can't have + اسم مفعول بیان می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: They ___ (may / leave) yesterday, but I did not check.
exercises.why_en: A past possibility uses may have + past participle.
exercises.why_fa: احتمال در گذشته با may have + اسم مفعول می‌آید.

exam.q: The ground is wet; it ___ last night.
exam.why_en: A past event inferred with certainty.
exam.why_fa: رخدادی در گذشته که با اطمینان استنباط می‌شود.

exam.q: That ___ be Sara at the door; she is in Tabriz.
exam.why_en: Knowing where she is makes the other possibility impossible.
exam.why_fa: وقتی می‌دانیم او کجاست، احتمال دیگر ممکن نیست.

exam.q: He ___ the message; his phone was off.
exam.why_en: A negative past possibility takes might not have.
exam.why_fa: احتمال منفی در گذشته با might not have می‌آید.

lessons.title: The passive
lessons.use_en: The passive puts the action or the result first and the doer last, or leaves the doer out when it is unknown or unimportant.
lessons.use_fa: مجهول کنش یا نتیجه را اول می‌آورد و کنندهٔ کار را آخر، یا وقتی کننده ناشناخته یا بی‌اهمیت است حذف می‌کند.
lessons.form_en: be (in the right tense) + past participle  (+ by + agent)

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1902.
examples.fa: پل در سال ۱۹۰۲ ساخته شد.

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.fa: انگلیسی در بسیاری از کشورها صحبت می‌شود.

examples.en: The letters have been sent.
examples.fa: نامه‌ها فرستاده شده‌اند.

exercises.prompt: This house ___ (build) by my grandfather in 1950.
exercises.why_en: Past passive: was + past participle.
exercises.why_fa: مجهول گذشته: was + اسم مفعول.

exercises.prompt: The results ___ (announce) tomorrow morning.
exercises.why_en: Future passive: will be + past participle.
exercises.why_fa: مجهول آینده: will be + اسم مفعول.

exercises.prompt: The problem ___ (already / solve).
exercises.why_en: Present perfect passive, with already between has and been.
exercises.why_fa: مجهول حال کامل، با already میان has و been.

exam.q: The office ___ every evening.
exam.why_en: Someone cleans it; the office does not clean.
exam.why_fa: کسی آن را تمیز می‌کند؛ خودِ دفتر تمیز نمی‌شود.

exam.q: The cake ___ by my sister.
exam.why_en: Past passive with the doer named by by.
exam.why_fa: مجهولِ گذشته، با ذکر فاعل به‌وسیلهٔ by.

exam.q: These shoes ___ in Italy.
exam.why_en: A general fact about where they come from.
exam.why_fa: واقعیتی کلی دربارهٔ محل ساخت آن‌ها.

lessons.title: The passive with modals, get and stative verbs
lessons.title_fa: مجهول با افعال کمکی، get و فعل‌های حالتی
lessons.use_en: After a modal the passive is modal + be + past participle. Get with the past participle is a less formal passive, and some verbs are passive in meaning.
lessons.use_fa: پس از افعال کمکی، مجهول به شکل کمکی + be + اسم مفعول می‌آید. get با اسم مفعول مجهولِ غیررسمی‌تر است و بعضی فعل‌ها معنای مجهولی دارند.
lessons.form_en: must / can / will + be + past participle   |   get + past participle

examples.en: This form must be signed by the manager.
examples.fa: این فرم باید به امضای مدیر برسد.

examples.en: The window got broken during the storm.
examples.fa: پنجره در طوفان شکست.

examples.en: She is interested in old movies.
examples.fa: او به فیلم‌های قدیمی علاقه دارد.

exercises.prompt: The report ___ (must / write) before Friday.
exercises.why_en: A modal passive is modal + be + past participle.
exercises.why_fa: مجهول با فعل کمکی، کمکی + be + اسم مفعول است.

exercises.prompt: His bike ___ (get / steal) last week.
exercises.why_en: Get in the past with the past participle is an informal passive.
exercises.why_fa: get در گذشته با اسم مفعول، مجهولِ غیررسمی می‌سازد.

exercises.prompt: We ___ (be / satisfy) with the result.
exercises.why_en: Satisfied is a stative passive adjective.
exercises.why_fa: satisfied صفت مجهولیِ حالتی است.

exam.q: All the tickets ___ before the show.
exam.why_en: The tickets are sold by someone, so the passive after must.
exam.why_fa: بلیت‌ها به دست کسی فروخته می‌شوند، پس پس از must مجهول می‌آید.

exam.q: She ___ in modern art.
exam.why_en: -ed describes how she feels; -ing would describe the art.
exam.why_fa: شکل -ed احساس او را می‌گوید و شکل -ing خودِ هنر را توصیف می‌کند.

exam.q: The letters ___ yesterday.
exam.why_en: A past informal passive needs got and the past participle.
exam.why_fa: مجهول غیررسمی در گذشته به got و اسم مفعول نیاز دارد.

lessons.title: Noun clauses and reported speech
lessons.title_fa: جملات اسمی و نقل قول غیرمستقیم
lessons.use_en: A noun clause is a whole sentence doing the job of a noun: it can be the object of know, ask or say. In reported speech the tense usually steps back one, and question word order becomes statement order.
lessons.use_fa: جملهٔ اسمی، جمله‌ای کامل است که نقش اسم را بازی می‌کند: مفعول know، ask یا say می‌شود. در نقل قول غیرمستقیم زمان معمولاً یک پله عقب می‌رود و ترتیب پرسشی به ترتیب خبری تبدیل می‌شود.
lessons.form_en: I don't know + where/what/if (subject + verb)  |  He said (that) + subject + verb

examples.en: I don't know where he lives.
examples.fa: نمی‌دانم کجا زندگی می‌کند.

examples.en: She asked if I was ready.
examples.fa: او پرسید آیا آماده‌ام.

examples.en: He said he would come later.
examples.fa: او گفت بعداً می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: Do you know where ___ (she / live)?
exercises.why_en: Inside a noun clause the word order is statement order, and the verb agrees.
exercises.why_fa: در جملهٔ اسمی ترتیب خبری است و فعل با نهاد هم‌خوان می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: He told me he ___ (be) busy that day.
exercises.why_en: Reported speech steps the present back to the past.
exercises.why_fa: در نقل غیرمستقیم حال به گذشته تبدیل می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: I can't remember if I ___ (lock) the door.
exercises.why_en: If introduces the clause, and the locking is past.
exercises.why_fa: if جمله را می‌آورد و قفل‌کردن در گذشته رخ داده است.

exam.q: She asked me ___ I had finished.
exam.why_en: A yes/no question becomes if or whether.
exam.why_fa: پرسش بله/خیر با if یا whether نقل می‌شود.

exam.q: I don't understand ___ he is angry.
exam.why_en: The missing idea is a reason.
exam.why_fa: مفهومِ جاافتاده دلیل است.

exam.q: He said he ___ the movie before.
exam.why_en: The seeing is earlier than the saying.
exam.why_fa: دیدن پیش‌تر از گفتن رخ داده بود.

lessons.title: The subjunctive in noun clauses: insist that he be
lessons.title_fa: وجه شرطی در جمله‌واره‌های اسمی: insist that he be
lessons.use_en: After insist, recommend, suggest, request and demand, the that-clause uses the base verb for every person: that he be, that they go.
lessons.use_fa: پس از insist، recommend، suggest، request و demand، در جمله‌وارهٔ that فعل برای همهٔ اشخاص به شکل ساده می‌آید: that he be، that they go.
lessons.form_en: insist / suggest / recommend + that + subject + base verb

examples.en: The doctor insists that he rest for a week.
examples.fa: دکتر اصرار دارد که او یک هفته استراحت کند.

examples.en: They recommended that she apply again.
examples.fa: توصیه کردند که او دوباره درخواست بدهد.

examples.en: It is essential that everyone be on time.
examples.fa: ضروری است که همه سر وقت باشند.

exercises.prompt: The manager requested that the report ___ (be) ready by noon.
exercises.why_en: The subjunctive uses the base form after requested that.
exercises.why_fa: پس از requested that، وجه شرطی شکل سادهٔ فعل را می‌آورد.

exercises.prompt: I suggest that he ___ (take) the earlier train.
exercises.why_en: Suggest that takes the base verb, without -s.
exercises.why_fa: suggest that فعل ساده می‌گیرد، بدون -s.

exercises.prompt: It is important that she ___ (not / miss) the meeting.
exercises.why_en: The negative subjunctive puts not before the base verb.
exercises.why_fa: وجه شرطی منفی، not را پیش از فعل ساده می‌آورد.

exam.q: They insisted that the meeting ___ open to everyone.
exam.why_en: Insist that is followed by the base form.
exam.why_fa: پس از insist that شکل ساده می‌آید.

exam.q: The committee recommended that he ___ the offer.
exam.why_en: No -s in the subjunctive, even with he.
exam.why_fa: در وجه شرطی حتی با he هم -s نمی‌آید.

exam.q: It is vital that the door ___ locked at night.
exam.why_en: It is vital that takes the subjunctive be.
exam.why_fa: it is vital that وجه شرطی be را می‌آورد.

lessons.title: Adjective clauses
lessons.use_en: An adjective clause describes a noun and follows it: who for people, which for things, whose for possession, where for places. The clause pronoun can be left out when it is the object.
lessons.use_fa: جملهٔ وصفی اسم را توصیف می‌کند و بعد از آن می‌آید: who برای افراد، which برای اشیا، whose برای مالکیت و where برای مکان. اگر ضمیر موصولی مفعول باشد، می‌توان آن را حذف کرد.
lessons.form_en: noun + who / which / that / whose / where + subject + verb

examples.en: The woman who called is my aunt.
examples.fa: زنی که زنگ زد خالهٔ من است.

examples.en: This is the book I told you about.
examples.fa: این همان کتابی است که درباره‌اش گفتم.

examples.en: The man whose car was stolen called the police.
examples.fa: مردی که ماشینش دزدیده شد به پلیس زنگ زد.

exercises.prompt: The teacher ___ teaches us math is from Yazd. (person)
exercises.why_en: A person is the subject of the clause, so who (or that).
exercises.why_fa: شخص نهاد جملهٔ وصفی است، پس who یا that.

exercises.prompt: That's the café ___ we met. (place)
exercises.why_en: Where replaces a place phrase such as in that café.
exercises.why_fa: where جای عبارت مکانی مثل in that café را می‌گیرد.

exercises.prompt: I have a friend ___ father is a pilot. (possession)
exercises.why_en: Whose shows that the father belongs to the friend.
exercises.why_fa: whose نشان می‌دهد پدر به آن دوست تعلق دارد.

exam.q: The movie ___ we watched was boring.
exam.why_en: A movie is a thing.
exam.why_fa: فیلم یک چیز است، پس which.

exam.q: The girl ___ bag was lost is crying.
exam.why_en: The bag belongs to the girl.
exam.why_fa: کیف مال دختر است، پس whose.

exam.q: This is the house ___ I was born.
exam.why_en: A place is being described.
exam.why_fa: مکان توصیف می‌شود، پس where.

lessons.title: Reducing adjective clauses to phrases
lessons.use_en: An adjective clause with be can drop the pronoun and be: the man who is standing there becomes the man standing there. Without be, the verb becomes -ing.
lessons.use_fa: جمله‌وارهٔ وصفی که فعل be دارد می‌تواند ضمیر و be را حذف کند: the man who is standing there به the man standing there تبدیل می‌شود. اگر be نباشد، فعل به ing تبدیل می‌شود.
lessons.form_en: the girl who is singing -> the girl singing   |   the car that was stolen -> the car stolen

examples.en: The woman standing at the gate is my aunt.
examples.fa: زنی که دم در ایستاده خالهٔ من است.

examples.en: The letter written last week was never sent.
examples.fa: نامه‌ای که هفتهٔ پیش نوشته شد هرگز فرستاده نشد.

examples.en: Students hoping to pass should read the notes.
examples.fa: دانش‌آموزانی که امید به قبولی دارند باید جزوه را بخوانند.

exercises.prompt: The boy ___ (who / play) the guitar is my cousin.
exercises.why_en: The active verb becomes -ing when the pronoun is dropped.
exercises.why_fa: فعل معلوم با حذف ضمیر به ing تبدیل می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: The houses ___ (that / build) last year are already sold.
exercises.why_en: A passive clause reduces to the past participle.
exercises.why_fa: جمله‌وارهٔ مجهول به اسم مفعول کوتاه می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: Anyone ___ (who / need) help can ask me.
exercises.why_en: The clause who needs becomes the -ing phrase needing.
exercises.why_fa: جمله‌وارهٔ who needs به عبارت ing یعنی needing تبدیل می‌شود.

exam.q: The car ___ outside belongs to the doctor.
exam.why_en: The car is parked, so the passive participle is used.
exam.why_fa: ماشین پارک شده است، پس اسم مفعول مجهول می‌آید.

exam.q: People ___ in the line waited for hours.
exam.why_en: The people were standing, so the active -ing phrase fits.
exam.why_fa: مردم ایستاده بودند، پس عبارت ing معلوم درست است.

exam.q: The report ___ yesterday was excellent.
exam.why_en: The report was submitted, so the past participle.
exam.why_fa: گزارش ارائه شده بود، پس اسم مفعول.

lessons.title: Gerunds and infinitives
lessons.title_fa: اسم‌های مصدری و مصدر با to
lessons.use_en: Some verbs are followed by -ing, some by to + verb, and a few by either with a change of meaning. After a preposition the form is always -ing.
lessons.use_fa: برخی فعل‌ها با ing- می‌آیند، برخی با to + فعل، و چند فعل با هر دو — با تغییری در معنا. بعد از حرف اضافه همیشه ing- می‌آید.
lessons.form_en: verb + -ing  |  verb + to + base  |  preposition + -ing

examples.en: I enjoy reading before bed.
examples.fa: قبل از خواب از خواندن لذت می‌برم.

examples.en: She decided to leave early.
examples.fa: او تصمیم گرفت زود برود.

examples.en: Thank you for helping me.
examples.fa: ممنون که به من کمک کردی.

exercises.prompt: I want ___ (learn) Japanese.
exercises.why_en: Want is followed by the infinitive.
exercises.why_fa: want با مصدر to می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: He finished ___ (write) the report.
exercises.why_en: Finish takes -ing, not the infinitive.
exercises.why_fa: finish با ing- می‌آید نه با to.

exercises.prompt: She is good at ___ (solve) problems.
exercises.why_en: At is a preposition, so the verb takes -ing.
exercises.why_fa: at حرف اضافه است، پس فعل ing- می‌گیرد.

exam.q: They agreed ___ the price.
exam.why_en: Agree takes the infinitive.
exam.why_fa: agree با مصدر می‌آید.

exam.q: I don't mind ___ early.
exam.why_en: Mind is followed by -ing.
exam.why_fa: بعد از mind فعل -ing می‌آید.

exam.q: He stopped ___ two years ago.
exam.why_en: Stopped smoking means he gave it up; stopped to smoke would mean he paused in order to smoke.
exam.why_fa: stopped smoking یعنی ترک کرد؛ stopped to smoke یعنی برای سیگار کشیدن ایستاد.

lessons.title: Causative verbs: make, have, get, let and help
lessons.title_fa: فعل‌های سببی: make، have، get، let و help
lessons.use_en: Make, have and let take the base verb; get takes the infinitive with to; help accepts either form.
lessons.use_fa: make، have و let فعل ساده می‌گیرند؛ get مصدر با to می‌گیرد؛ help هر دو شکل را می‌پذیرد.
lessons.form_en: make / have / let + person + verb   |   get + person + to + verb

examples.en: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
examples.fa: معلم ما را مجبور کرد انشا را دوباره بنویسیم.

examples.en: I had the mechanic check the brakes.
examples.fa: از مکانیک خواستم ترمزها را بررسی کند.

examples.en: She got her brother to carry the boxes.
examples.fa: او برادرش را راضی کرد جعبه‌ها را حمل کند.

exercises.prompt: Let me ___ (help) you with that.
exercises.why_en: Let takes the base verb without to.
exercises.why_fa: پس از let فعل ساده و بدون to می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: They got the children ___ (clean) the room.
exercises.why_en: Get takes the infinitive with to.
exercises.why_fa: پس از get مصدر با to می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: His joke made everyone ___ (laugh).
exercises.why_en: Make takes the base verb.
exercises.why_fa: پس از make فعل ساده می‌آید.

exam.q: The manager had the contract ___ by a lawyer.
exam.why_en: Have something done uses the past participle.
exam.why_fa: ساختار have something done اسم مفعول می‌گیرد.

exam.q: I will get him ___ the car.
exam.why_en: Get a person to do something takes the to-infinitive.
exam.why_fa: get someone to do something مصدر با to می‌گیرد.

exam.q: Her story made me ___ .
exam.why_en: Make takes the base verb, never to.
exam.why_fa: پس از make فعل ساده می‌آید، هرگز to.

lessons.title: Paired conjunctions and parallel structure
lessons.title_fa: حروف ربط جفتی و ساختار موازی
lessons.use_en: Both ... and, not only ... but also, either ... or and neither ... nor join two things of the same grammatical kind. Whatever follows the first half must match whatever follows the second.
lessons.use_fa: both ... and، not only ... but also، either ... or و neither ... nor دو چیز از یک نوع دستوری را به هم وصل می‌کنند. آنچه بعد از بخش اول می‌آید باید با بخش دوم هم‌شکل باشد.
lessons.form_en: both A and B  |  not only A but also B  |  either A or B  |  neither A nor B

examples.en: Both my sister and my brother live abroad.
examples.fa: هم خواهرم و هم برادرم خارج از کشور زندگی می‌کنند.

examples.en: She is not only clever but also kind.
examples.fa: او نه‌تنها باهوش است بلکه مهربان هم هست.

examples.en: We can either walk or take a taxi.
examples.fa: می‌توانیم یا پیاده برویم یا تاکسی بگیریم.

exercises.prompt: Neither the manager ___ the staff were told.
exercises.why_en: Neither is finished by nor, never by or.
exercises.why_fa: neither با nor کامل می‌شود، نه با or.

exercises.prompt: He is not only a teacher ___ a writer.
exercises.why_en: The pair is not only ... but also.
exercises.why_fa: جفت درست not only ... but also است.

exercises.prompt: She likes ___ swimming and running. (first half)
exercises.why_en: Both pairs with and, and both halves are -ing forms.
exercises.why_fa: both با and می‌آید و دو نیمه هر دو ing- هستند.

exam.q: ___ you apologize or you leave.
exam.why_en: Either ... or offers two options.
exam.why_fa: either … or دو گزینه پیش می‌گذارد.

exam.q: The apartment is both small ___ comfortable.
exam.why_en: Both is completed by and.
exam.why_fa: both با and کامل می‌شود.

exam.q: Neither the food ___ the service was good.
exam.why_en: Neither ... nor is the pair.
exam.why_fa: جفتِ درست neither … nor است.

lessons.title: Adverb clauses: time, cause, contrast and condition
lessons.title_fa: جملات قیدی: زمان، علت، تضاد و شرط
lessons.use_en: An adverb clause answers when, why, in spite of what, or under what condition. It can come before the main clause (with a comma) or after it (without one).
lessons.use_fa: جملهٔ قیدی می‌گوید کِی، چرا، با وجود چه چیزی، یا تحت چه شرطی. می‌تواند پیش از جملهٔ اصلی بیاید (با ویرگول) یا پس از آن (بدون ویرگول).
lessons.form_en: when / while / because / although / if / unless + subject + verb

examples.en: While I was waiting, I read the news.
examples.fa: وقتی منتظر بودم، خبرها را خواندم.

examples.en: Although she was tired, she finished the work.
examples.fa: با اینکه خسته بود، کار را تمام کرد.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
examples.fa: اگر باران بیاید، خانه می‌مانیم.

exercises.prompt: ___ it was late, we decided to walk home. (cause)
exercises.why_en: A reason is being given, so because (or since).
exercises.why_fa: دلیل گفته می‌شود، پس because یا since.

exercises.prompt: ___ she studied hard, she failed the test. (unexpected)
exercises.why_en: The result is unexpected, which although marks.
exercises.why_fa: نتیجه غیرمنتظره است و although همین را نشان می‌دهد.

exercises.prompt: You can't enter ___ you show your ticket. (condition)
exercises.why_en: Unless means if not.
exercises.why_fa: unless یعنی «اگر نه».

exam.q: I'll call you ___ I arrive.
exam.why_en: A time relationship.
exam.why_fa: رابطهٔ زمانی است.

exam.q: We stayed inside ___ the heat.
exam.why_en: A noun phrase (the heat) follows, so because of.
exam.why_fa: پس از آن عبارت اسمی (the heat) می‌آید، پس because of.

exam.q: ___ you hurry, you will miss the train.
exam.why_en: The warning is about not hurrying.
exam.why_fa: هشدار دربارهٔ عجله نکردن است، پس unless.

lessons.title: Reducing adverb clauses to modifying phrases
lessons.use_en: When the adverb clause and the main clause share a subject, drop the subject and change the verb: Before I left, I called becomes Before leaving, I called. With be, drop the pronoun and be.
lessons.use_fa: وقتی جمله‌وارهٔ قیدی و جملهٔ اصلی فاعل یکسان دارند، فاعل حذف می‌شود و فعل تغییر می‌کند: Before I left, I called به Before leaving, I called تبدیل می‌شود. با be، ضمیر و be حذف می‌شوند.
lessons.form_en: Before leaving, ...   |   While walking home, ...   |   Having finished, ...

examples.en: After finishing the report, she went home.
examples.fa: پس از تمام‌کردن گزارش، به خانه رفت.

examples.en: While walking to work, I met an old friend.
examples.fa: در راه رفتن به سر کار، دوست قدیمی‌ای دیدم.

examples.en: Having eaten, the children went out to play.
examples.fa: بعد از غذا، بچه‌ها برای بازی بیرون رفتند.

exercises.prompt: Before ___ (leave), turn off the lights.
exercises.why_en: The subject you is shared, so the clause becomes before + -ing.
exercises.why_fa: فاعل you مشترک است، پس جمله‌واره به before + ing تبدیل می‌شود.

exercises.prompt: While ___ (wait) for the bus, he read the news.
exercises.why_en: While with a shared subject takes the -ing form.
exercises.why_fa: while با فاعل مشترک شکل ing می‌گیرد.

exercises.prompt: ___ (finish) the work, they closed the office.
exercises.why_en: Having + past participle shows the first action was complete.
exercises.why_fa: having + اسم مفعول نشان می‌دهد کار اول تمام شده بود.

exam.q: After ___ the letter, he posted it.
exam.why_en: After with a shared subject takes -ing.
exam.why_fa: after با فاعل مشترک ing می‌گیرد.

exam.q: ___ driving home, she listened to music.
exam.why_en: While introduces the -ing phrase; during takes a noun.
exam.why_fa: while عبارت ing را می‌آورد؛ during اسم می‌گیرد.

exam.q: ___ seen the movie twice, he knew the ending.
exam.why_en: Having + past participle marks the earlier completed action.
exam.why_fa: having + اسم مفعول کارِ قبلیِ تمام‌شده را نشان می‌دهد.

lessons.title: Connectives: because of, therefore, so that, otherwise
lessons.title_fa: حروف ربط: because of، therefore، so that، otherwise
lessons.use_en: Because of and due to take a noun; therefore, consequently and so join a result; so that gives a purpose; otherwise and or else give a condition.
lessons.use_fa: because of و due to اسم می‌گیرند؛ therefore، consequently و so نتیجه را وصل می‌کنند؛ so that هدف را می‌گوید؛ otherwise و or else شرط را می‌سازند.
lessons.form_en: because of + noun   |   sentence; therefore, sentence   |   so that + subject + modal

examples.en: The flight was canceled because of the fog.
examples.fa: پرواز به‌خاطر مه لغو شد.

examples.en: The road was closed; therefore, we took the train.
examples.fa: جاده بسته بود؛ بنابراین با قطار رفتیم.

examples.en: Leave now, otherwise you will miss the bus.
examples.fa: حالا راه بیفت، وگرنه اتوبوس را از دست می‌دهی.

exercises.prompt: We stayed home ___ the heavy rain.
exercises.why_en: A noun phrase (the heavy rain) follows, so because of.
exercises.why_fa: پس از آن عبارت اسمی (the heavy rain) می‌آید، پس because of.

exercises.prompt: She studied hard; ___, she passed easily.
exercises.why_en: A result after a semicolon takes therefore.
exercises.why_fa: نتیجه پس از نقطه‌ویرگول با therefore می‌آید.

exercises.prompt: Write it down ___ you do not forget.
exercises.why_en: A purpose before a subject and modal takes so that.
exercises.why_fa: هدف پیش از فاعل و فعل کمکی با so that بیان می‌شود.

exam.q: ___ the strike, all trains stopped.
exam.why_en: A noun follows, so the two-word preposition is needed.
exam.why_fa: پس از آن اسم می‌آید، پس حرف اضافهٔ دوکلمه‌ای لازم است.

exam.q: He left early, ___ he would not miss the flight.
exam.why_en: Purpose before a subject and modal is so that.
exam.why_fa: هدف پیش از فاعل و فعل کمکی با so that می‌آید.

exam.q: Take a map; ___ you will get lost.
exam.why_en: The warning about what happens if not is otherwise.
exam.why_fa: هشدار دربارهٔ نتیجهٔ انجام‌ندادن با otherwise می‌آید.

lessons.title: Conditionals and wishes
lessons.use_en: The first conditional is a real possibility: if + present, will + verb. The second is unreal in the present: if + past, would + verb. The third is unreal in the past: if + had + participle, would have + participle. Wish follows the same steps backwards.
lessons.use_fa: شرطی نوع اول امکان واقعی است: if + حال، will + فعل. نوع دوم در زمان حال غیرواقعی است: if + گذشته، would + فعل. نوع سوم در گذشته غیرواقعی است: if + had + اسم مفعول، would have + اسم مفعول. wish هم همین پله‌ها را به عقب می‌رود.
lessons.form_en: if + present → will  |  if + past → would  |  if + had + p.p. → would have + p.p.

examples.en: If it rains, we will stay in.
examples.fa: اگر باران بیاید، خانه می‌مانیم.

examples.en: If I had more time, I would travel.
examples.fa: اگر وقت بیشتری داشتم، سفر می‌کردم.

examples.en: If she had studied, she would have passed.
examples.fa: اگر درس خوانده بود، قبول می‌شد.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ (know) the answer, I would tell you.
exercises.why_en: An unreal present condition takes the past form, not the present.
exercises.why_fa: شرط غیرواقعی در حال، شکل گذشته می‌گیرد نه حال.

exercises.prompt: If you heat ice, it ___ (melt).
exercises.why_en: A general truth: if + present, present.
exercises.why_fa: یک حقیقت کلی: if + حال، حال.

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ (not / say) that yesterday.
exercises.why_en: A wish about the past takes the past perfect.
exercises.why_fa: آرزو دربارهٔ گذشته با گذشتهٔ کامل می‌آید.

exam.q: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
exam.why_en: Unreal present: were for all persons in this pattern.
exam.why_fa: حالِ غیرواقعی: در این ساختار برای همهٔ اشخاص were.

exam.q: She would have come if you ___ her.
exam.why_en: Third conditional: had + past participle.
exam.why_fa: شرطی نوع سوم: had + اسم مفعول.

exam.q: I wish I ___ taller.
exam.why_en: A wish about now takes the past form.
exam.why_fa: آرزو دربارهٔ حال، زمان گذشته می‌گیرد.
